description: A signature pad component that captures freehand drawing via pointer events and renders strokes as SVG polylines. Supports customization of stroke color, width, background, and disabled state.

parameters.name: BackgroundColor
parameters.description: Background color of the canvas. When null, the canvas is transparent.

parameters.name: Changed
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the captured signature value changes.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class for the wrapper element.

parameters.name: Confirmed
parameters.description: Whether to show an explicit confirmation button for the current signature.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: When true, the canvas is read-only and the clear button is hidden.

parameters.name: ExportFormat
parameters.description: Capture modes shown in the mode selector.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: Canvas height in pixels. Default is 200.

parameters.name: Initials
parameters.description: Whether the component is disabled.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the signature value or signing metadata changes.

parameters.name: ModeChanged
parameters.description: Current capture mode. Defaults to draw mode.

parameters.name: Modes
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the active capture mode changes.

parameters.name: OnQrSigningRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the upload flow should be opened.

parameters.name: OnUploadRequested
parameters.description: Previously saved signature value that can be reused.

parameters.name: PreviousValue
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the current signature is explicitly confirmed.

parameters.name: Required
parameters.description: Export format used when drawing signatures. Defaults to SVG.

parameters.name: RequireReason
parameters.description: Optional SVG background color.

parameters.name: ShowClearButton
parameters.description: Whether to show the clear button. Default is true.

parameters.name: ShowConfirmButton
parameters.description: Whether to show a QR/mobile signing button.

parameters.name: ShowQrSigningButton
parameters.description: Whether to show the remember signature checkbox.

parameters.name: ShowRememberSignature
parameters.description: Whether a reason input should be shown.

parameters.name: StrokeColor
parameters.description: Stroke color. Default is #000000.

parameters.name: StrokeWidth
parameters.description: Stroke width in pixels. Default is 2.

parameters.name: TypedFont
parameters.description: Whether typed mode should collect initials instead of a full signature.

parameters.name: ValueChanged
parameters.description: Event fired when the signature value changes.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: Canvas width in pixels. Default is 400.
